t.p: Connect a new account using its credentials.

ol.li: Paste the token from your bot’s administrator into Bot token.
Leave Webhook secret empty to generate one.
Click Verify bot. Check the bot details, then continue.

t.p: The bot ID is filled automatically. You do not need to enter the database name.
Select a saved connection. Its token and webhook secret are reused; you do not need to enter them again.
Click Verify bot to check a Telegram connection, then continue through the remaining steps.
If the list shows No records, clear your search or choose Create new connection. The list only includes accounts for the selected company, team and channel type.
A bot already assigned to another channel cannot be reused here. Switching choices clears unsaved credentials.
Telegram must be able to reach this server over HTTPS. A localhost address works only on your computer. Choose Set up receiving later to finish the other details without enabling messages.

details.p: The callback URL uses the configured public domain and this channel’s generated route key. Advanced settings contains the webhook secret, test-user authorization and retention periods.
Register the callback URL with Telegram using the webhook secret as secret_token and subscribe to message and edited_message updates. This wizard does not register the webhook automatically.
Verify webhook checks whether Telegram has the displayed URL registered. It does not register a webhook or prove message delivery. Send a test message to confirm delivery.

t.p: The display name and description help your colleagues recognize this channel in Odoo. They do not change the provider account’s public profile or credentials.

The company and team become fixed once a connection is bound. A team can have several channels, each with its own provider identity. The Inbox is currently available; the form identifies business-app integrations that are not yet supported.

ol.li: Have an authorized test user send a private message to your bot.
Select the received conversation and enter a test reply.
Review the approval policy and activate sandbox replies explicitly when ready.
Click Review test reply to open a draft. Sending still requires recipient permission and the normal approval process.

t.p: If no conversation appears, ask your administrator to check webhook registration and inbound processing. Finish setup saves the channel; it does not send the test reply or enable scheduled processing.

div.div: This channel type needs an installed provider adapter before it can connect, send or receive. You can save its configuration now.
div.p: Setup does not send a test message or activate delivery automatically.
